systems.system: portal of the national police (online national identity card renewal)
systems.tiers: Online for the form, supporting documents and stamp fees; biometric capture still at an enrolment office. Announced in May 2026 at the DGSN Open Days in Rabat; also used to follow requests for residency certificates

note: The police portal here serves identity card renewal and residency certificates, a public service of the national identity system; the Mon e-ID application and the planned digital wallet are identity products. Nothing on how a station records a report or a case.
